summary: Full package upgrade deferred after isolated compatibility check detects Perl repository version skew
changes: No installed packages, KDE settings, GPU policies, repository priorities or service configuration were changed. Refreshed only the isolated repository metadata, downloaded and signature-checked candidate packages, extracted selected module files into private diagnostic storage and wrote maintenance records. Pending versions remain Graphviz 16.1.0-2, perl-html-parser 3.86-2.1 and Texinfo 7.3-3.1.
tests: ChatGPT OAuth status valid. Before diagnostics, pacman -Dk and pacman -Qkk on the three installed packages passed; gv and HTML::Parser imports passed; no failed system units. Full transaction preview proposes only the three packages, retaining Perl 5.42.3-1.1. Candidate HTML::Parser module and its XS library extracted from the signed package fail isolated import with exit 255 and undefined symbol Perl_newSVsv_flags_NN. Candidate archive uses the Perl 5.44 vendor directory. Graphviz candidate also retains its 5.44 vendor directory, matching the prior documented regression. Candidate Texinfo was downloaded and checked for integrity but not functionally evaluated. Final installed module imports, database and package integrity checks pass; two Graphviz SVG and Texinfo conversion checks pass. Installed-package inventory and monitored configuration hashes equal baseline; no failed units; timer active and SDDM enabled.
rollback: No package transaction was executed, so no package rollback was necessary. Existing installed versions and prior recovery archives remain intact. Diagnostic downloads, isolated metadata and private audit records are retained. No package pins or exclusions were added.
problem: The preferred optimized repository selects Perl 5.42.3-1.1 while the proposed HTML::Parser package targets Perl 5.44 and cannot load with the installed interpreter. A complete update would introduce a demonstrated module failure.
solution: Retained the working installed package set and deferred the complete transaction. Recheck when configured repositories offer a compatible interpreter and module set. No repository reorder, manual interpreter replacement or rebuild was attempted.
reproduction: Preview the full transaction using freshly synchronized isolated repository metadata. Compare selected Perl version with the candidate HTML::Parser archive vendor directory. Extract the candidate Parser.pm and its auto/HTML/Parser/Parser.so into a private temporary directory and import it using the installed Perl with that vendor directory added to its module search path. The candidate fails with an undefined Perl symbol while the installed module imports successfully.
